title: BITEM at the NTCIR-19 R2C2 Task: Predicting Confidence from Agentic RAG Pipeline Signals

paragraphs.en: The BITEM team entered both subtasks of the NTCIR-19 R2C2 task with a single agentic pipeline, in which a model searches, reads and records evidence over a movie corpus while an orchestrator holds the record and rules on what may be submitted. A claim is admitted only once an entailment cascade has checked it against the passage it cites, and an answer is released only once enough checked evidence stands behind it. Each question is run three or four times, every pass retrieving from a corpus stripped of what the earlier passes have already seen. The confidence filed with each answer is computed by the orchestrator from what the run leaves behind and is never asked of the model, which is offered no way to rate itself. The two retrieval runs placed 4th and 5th of 22, pooling the passes was worth 0.0709 nDCG@20, and the gain was largest on the multi-hop and post-processing-heavy questions, where the organisers rank the pooled run top of the field. Sixteen of the 25 answer runs were built on passages these two runs supplied, 12 of them filed by other teams. HMR rewards a system whose confidence is high where it answers right and low where it answers wrong. The pipeline reached an accuracy of 0.9219, 6th of 25, while the confidence filed with those answers gave an HMR of 0.4915, 13th. A few rules crafted over those same recorded signals, with no further model call and no further retrieval, raise that to an accuracy of 0.9375, 5th, and an HMR of 0.6985, 9th. Ranking on HMR alone can reward a system for answering wrongly with low confidence, so we propose accHMR, the accuracy multiplied by HMR, which reports the reward in proportion to the accuracy, and on which the revised rules would have scored 0.6549, 5th. For future work, fitting a model on the numbers the pipeline already produces, rather than writing such rules by hand, would be a real step forward.
paragraphs.zh: BITEM 团队使用单一智能体流程参与了 NTCIR-19 R2C2 任务的两个子任务：在该流程中，一个模型在电影语料库中搜索、阅读并记录证据，而一个协调器则负责管理记录并决定哪些内容可以提交。 只有在演绎级联检查了某个主张与其所引用的段落之间的关系后，该主张才会被采纳；而只有当足够多的经过验证的证据支持某个答案时，该答案才会被发布。 每个问题都会运行三到四次，每次运行都从已去除先前运行所见内容的语料库中检索信息。 每个答案的置信度由协调器根据运行结果计算得出，从未要求模型自行提供；模型本身也没有任何自我评估的方式。 两次检索运行在 22 个结果中分别获得第 4 名和第 5 名，合并各次运行的结果获得了 0.0709 的 nDCG@20 值，其中多跳推理和重度后处理的问题增益最大，在这些问题上，组织方将合并后的运行结果列为全场第一。 在 25 个答案运行中，有 16 个是基于这两次运行提供的段落构建的，其中 12 个由其他团队提交。 HMR 会奖励那些在回答正确时置信度高、回答错误时置信度低的系统。 该流程的准确率达到 0.9219，在 25 个结果中排名第 6；而随这些答案一同提供的置信度则获得了 0.4915 的 HMR，排名第 13。 基于这些已记录信号制定的一些规则，无需进一步调用模型或进行检索，将准确率提升至 0.9375（第 5 名），HMR 提升至 0.6985（第 9 名）。 仅根据 HMR 排名可能会奖励那些以低置信度错误作答的系统，因此我们提出了 accHMR——即准确率乘以 HMR 的值，它能反映与准确率成比例的奖励；按照修订后的规则计算，该值为 0.6549，排名第 5。 在未来的工作中，基于该流程已生成的数据来训练模型，而不是手动编写此类规则，将是一个真正的进步。
